description: Answers printing and 4OVER4 support questions from 4OVER4's help center (bleed, file setup, paper, finishes, shipping, proofs, returns, custom quotes); use it for any how-to, policy or print term question. For one product's sizes or price use configure_product; for editorial pages use search_content. Requires the question as search words with the product or topic noun. Returns the answer, its source link and related questions. Customer phrases: "what is bleed", "my invitations arrived damaged", "are proofs free".

query.description: Search words for the question, with the product or topic noun, e.g. invitation misprint reprint refund.

topic.description: paper for a paper or stock recommendation, with the use case as query; free-business-cards for the 200 free business cards offer.

name: search_knowledge

data.description: The help answer, its source link and related questions.

link.description: The page on www.4over4.com to continue on: order, upload and checkout happen there.

summary.description: The facts of the result in plain sentences.
